# ZoliQua React Odontogram Modul — SVG tooth geometry

This folder contains SVG tooth templates from:

https://github.com/ZoliQua/React-Odontogram-Modul

Copyright (c) 2026 Zoltán Dul

Licensed under the MIT License. The full license text is in `LICENSE`.

The original SVG comments identify the assets as:

> Created by Zoltan Dul in 2026 - free to use with MIT license.
> Part of React Odontogram Modul - SVG Version: 2.5.0

MyOrganizer uses these files as **vector geometry source material**. They are
rendered with native WPF `Path` / `Geometry` / brushes. The React/TypeScript
odontogram engine is not included.
